definitions.explanation: A style of cooking where diners grill bite-sized pieces of meat (typically beef) at the table. Often served with various dipping sauces.

notes:
{焼肉|やきにく} (literally "grilled meat") refers to the dining style where meat is grilled at the table.

Popular cuts:
- ⟦カルビ→カルビ：noentry⟧ (short ribs)
- ⟦ロース→ロース：noentry⟧ (sirloin)
- ⟦タン→タン：noentry⟧ (tongue)
- ⟦ハラミ→ハラミ：noentry⟧ (skirt steak)
- ⟦ホルモン→ホルモン：29936_horumon⟧ (offal/innards)

Serving style:
- Meat is served raw and grilled on a ⟦{七輪|しちりん}→七輪：28597_shichirin⟧ (charcoal grill) or gas grill
- Dipped in ⟦タレ→タレ：10500_tare⟧ (sweet soy-based sauce) or ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧ (salt)
- Often eaten with ⟦{ライス|らいす}→ライス：08838_raisu⟧ (rice) or ⟦{冷麺|れいめん}→冷麺：noentry⟧ (cold noodles)

Often eaten for celebrations or group gatherings.

{焼肉|やきにく}⟦{食|た}べ{放題|ほうだい}→食べ放題：08291_tabehoudai⟧ (all-you-can-eat yakiniku) is popular.
